    Core Kalman Filter for Linear State-Space Models

    kalman_filter_core.Rd

    Evaluates the log-likelihood objective function and extracts filtered state trajectories via the Kalman filter prediction error decomposition for linear Gaussian state-space models.

    kalman_filter_core(
  Y_t,
  nu_t,
  H,
  N,
  mu_t,
  G,
  M,
  Sigma_0,
  rho_0,
  indic_pos = 0,
  Rfunction = Rf,
  Qfunction = Qf,
  reconciliationf = function(x, opt) {
     x
 }
)

    Arguments

    Y_t

    Matrix (\(T \times n_y\)) of observed series.

    nu_t

    Matrix (\(T \times n_\rho\)) of state transition intercepts/deterministic shifts.

    H

    Matrix (\(n_\rho \times n_\rho\)) state transition matrix.

    N

    Matrix (\(n_\rho \times \dots\)) defining the state innovation covariance \(Q = N N^\top\).

    mu_t

    Matrix (\(T \times n_y\)) of exogenous observation intercepts.

    G

    Matrix (\(n_y \times n_\rho\)) measurement mapping matrix.

    M

    Matrix (\(n_y \times \dots\)) defining the measurement error covariance \(R = M M^\top\).

    Sigma_0

    Matrix (\(n_\rho \times n_\rho\)) initial prior state covariance.

    rho_0

    Matrix (\(n_\rho \times 1\)) initial prior state vector.

    indic_pos

    Vector or integer indicating indices of state variables subject to non-negativity constraints. Defaults to 0.

    Rfunction

    Function returning the measurement error covariance matrix \(R_t\). Defaults to Rf.

    Qfunction

    Function returning the state innovation covariance matrix \(Q_t\). Defaults to Qf.

    reconciliationf

    Optional reconciliation function applied after the measurement update step. Defaults to identity.

    Value

    A list containing:

    r

    Filtered posterior state trajectories (\(\rho_{t|t}\)).

    Sigma_tt

    Flattened posterior state covariance matrices.

    loglik

    Scalar cumulative log-likelihood value.

    y_tp1_t

    Prior one-step-ahead measurement forecasts (\(Y_{t|t-1}\)).

    S_tp1_t

    Flattened prior state covariance matrices (\(\Sigma_{t|t-1}\)).

    r_tp1_t

    Prior one-step-ahead state forecasts (\(\rho_{t|t-1}\)).

    loglik.vector

    Vector of step-by-step log-likelihood contributions.

    Omega_tp1_t

    Flattened forecast error covariance matrices (\(\Omega_{t|t-1}\)).

    M

    The measurement error factor matrix.

    fitted.obs

    Fitted in-sample observation estimates (\(\hat{Y}_{t|t}\)).

    Details

    The state-space model is formulated by the following core system equations:

    State (Transition) Equation: $$\rho_t = \nu_t + H \rho_{t-1} + \eta_t, \quad \eta_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0, Q_t)$$ where \(Q_t = N N^\top\).

    Observation (Measurement) Equation: $$Y_t = \mu_t + G \rho_t + \varepsilon_t, \quad \varepsilon_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0, R_t)$$ where \(R_t = M M^\top\).

    Missing observations in \(Y_t\) are handled dynamically via sub-matrix selection across the measurement update step.

    See also

    Rf, Qf, kalman_filter_taylor
